title: Global tenders
desc: Tenders collected from official public sources (World Bank, EU TED) and licensed providers, with the original source and reference shown on each one.
actions: Search by keyword, country or value

title: Supplier directory
desc: Public list of suppliers who chose to be listed. Featured suppliers appear first.
actions: Search suppliers by category or country

title: Consultancy services
desc: Tender preparation and consultancy services sold by PMC Managers.

title: Buyer application
desc: Banks, government departments, PSUs and companies apply to publish their own tenders.
actions: Submit the application for PMC approval

title: Language pages
desc: Every public page has its own address in each of the 14 languages, for example /fr for French. The flag button changes the language on any page.
actions: Pick a language from the flag button
Share a link in that language

title: Growth tools
desc: Buyer applications, consultancy services, supplier directory, global tender sources and Data API clients in one screen.

title: Translation review
desc: Native speakers check the AI translations used across the portal. Approve correct phrases or save a fix; reviewed phrases are never overwritten by AI.

title: Masters and fee rules
desc: Master lists, including pricing bands (country groups), tier names and fee rules for publishing, bids, awards, AI tools, featured listings and the Data API.
actions: Change a fee or set it to waived
